In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences. You'll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected.
